paragraphs: Shimon Narshia. See the entry Shimon bar Narshaya.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has נרשיא, Narshia; the target has נרשייא, Narshaya, and adds bar. These are conventional English vocalizations of distinct supplied spellings, retained without harmonization.
